verdict.rationale: Stripe's spending-controls docs say you can block merchant categories, countries and merchant IDs per card or cardholder, which covers MCC blocklists. The synchronous real-time authorization webhook lets you approve or decline each authorization live, so allowlist or single-merchant rules can be built in custom code. Missing for 10: explicit MCC allowlist support, a native single-merchant lock control, documentation that the built-in controls are enforced at authorization time, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
